name: bluesky-feed
description: Your Bluesky timeline in a side pane: the posts of the accounts you follow, a field to write and send a post, and a like button on every post. /bsky opens it. Logs in with a Bluesky app password; the free public API, no developer account.

handle.title: Bluesky handle
handle.description: Your handle, e.g. dan.bsky.social (with or without @); with none set the mod does nothing

appPassword.title: App password
appPassword.description: A Bluesky app password (Settings, Privacy and security, App passwords), never your account password. Used to read your timeline, post and like

service.title: Service (PDS)
service.description: Where your account lives; leave https://bsky.social unless you self-host

limit.title: Posts per page
limit.description: How many posts each read and each 'more' brings (10-50)

pollSeconds.title: Refresh interval (s)
pollSeconds.description: Seconds between refreshes while the pane is open (30-3600)

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the pane when the session starts; the engine keeps an unasked pane hidden below 144 columns
